title.en: OLIVE YOUNG Global: Get Ready for UV Care
title.es: OLIVE YOUNG Global: prepárate para el cuidado UV
title.zh: OLIVE YOUNG Global：夏季防晒护理活动
title.pt: OLIVE YOUNG Global: preparação para cuidados UV
title.ru: OLIVE YOUNG Global: уход и защита от UV

summary.en: A June beauty promotion focused on UV-care supplements, summer essentials, coupons, and limited gifts.
summary.es: Promoción de junio centrada en cuidado UV, esenciales de verano, cupones y regalos limitados.
summary.zh: 六月美妆促销，主打防晒护理、夏季必备、优惠券和限量赠品。
summary.pt: Promoção de junho com foco em cuidados UV, itens de verão, cupons e brindes limitados.
summary.ru: Июньская beauty-акция с UV-уходом, летними товарами, купонами и лимитированными подарками.

whyGo.en: Good for tourists comparing K-beauty deals before or during a Korea trip.
whyGo.es: Útil para turistas que comparan ofertas K-beauty antes o durante el viaje.
whyGo.zh: 适合来韩前后比较 K-beauty 优惠的游客。
whyGo.pt: Boa para turistas que querem comparar ofertas de K-beauty antes ou durante a viagem.
whyGo.ru: Полезно туристам, которые сравнивают K-beauty предложения до или во время поездки.

travelTips: Check whether your country is eligible before planning purchases.
Coupons and gifts may close early; use the official source before checkout.
For offline shopping in Korea, compare OLIVE YOUNG stores near Myeongdong, Hongdae, Seongsu, and Gangnam.

summary.en: A recently ended summer sale with coupon packs, app play zone, first-order perks, and hero brand picks.
summary.es: Venta de verano recién finalizada con cupones, zona de app, ventajas para primera compra y marcas destacadas.
summary.zh: 刚结束的夏季促销，包含优惠券包、App 活动、新客福利和热门品牌精选。
summary.pt: Liquidação de verão recém-encerrada com cupons, área do app, benefícios de primeira compra e marcas destaque.
summary.ru: Недавно завершившаяся летняя распродажа с купонами, app-зоной, бонусами для первого заказа и подборками брендов.

whyGo.en: Useful as a seasonal price benchmark for the next OLIVE YOUNG sale cycle.
whyGo.es: Sirve como referencia de precios para el próximo ciclo de ofertas.
whyGo.zh: 可作为下一轮 OLIVE YOUNG 大促的价格参考。
whyGo.pt: Serve como referência de preços para o próximo ciclo de promoção.
whyGo.ru: Подходит как ориентир цен для следующего цикла распродаж.

travelTips: Archive pages are kept for trend tracking, not as active offers.
Set this source to daily checks around March, June, September, and December.

summary.en: A citywide Busan project with media art, exhibitions, photo zones, pop-up stores, and fan activities around the tour dates.
summary.es: Proyecto urbano en Busan con arte multimedia, exposiciones, zonas de foto, pop-ups y actividades para fans.
summary.zh: 釜山市内项目，包含媒体艺术、展览、拍照区、快闪店和粉丝活动。
summary.pt: Projeto pela cidade de Busan com media art, exposições, photo zones, pop-ups e atividades para fãs.
summary.ru: Городской проект в Пусане с медиа-артом, выставками, фотозонами, pop-up магазинами и фан-активностями.

whyGo.en: High-intent K-pop travelers will spend time planning transport, lodging, merch, and nearby attractions.
whyGo.es: Viajeros K-pop suelen planificar transporte, alojamiento, merchandising y lugares cercanos.
whyGo.zh: K-pop 旅客通常会深入规划交通、住宿、周边商品和附近景点。
whyGo.pt: Viajantes de K-pop costumam planejar transporte, hospedagem, merch e atrações próximas.
whyGo.ru: K-pop туристы обычно подробно планируют транспорт, жилье, мерч и соседние места.

travelTips: Expect heavy demand near Haeundae, Gwangalli, Busan Station, and concert-linked venues.
Book KTX, hotel, and airport transfer early.
Use official reservation links for pop-ups; unofficial resale can be risky.

summary.en: Two Busan concert dates with related city events, safety guidance, and high travel demand.
summary.es: Dos fechas de concierto en Busan con eventos relacionados, guías de seguridad y alta demanda turística.
summary.zh: 釜山两场演唱会，伴随城市活动、安全指南和高旅行需求。
summary.pt: Duas datas de show em Busan com eventos relacionados, orientação de segurança e alta demanda turística.
summary.ru: Две концертные даты в Пусане с городскими событиями, советами по безопасности и высоким спросом.

whyGo.en: Concert pages attract repeat visits because transport, crowd control, lodging, and weather change quickly.
whyGo.es: Las páginas de conciertos atraen visitas repetidas porque transporte, multitudes, hoteles y clima cambian rápido.
whyGo.zh: 演唱会页面会吸引反复访问，因为交通、人流、住宿和天气变化很快。
whyGo.pt: Páginas de shows geram retornos porque transporte, multidões, hotéis e clima mudam rápido.
whyGo.ru: Страницы концертов получают повторные визиты, потому что транспорт, толпы, жилье и погода быстро меняются.

travelTips: Arrive early and plan a post-show subway or taxi fallback.
Check official crowd control notices on the day of travel.
Combine with Gwangalli, Haeundae, and local food routes outside peak show hours.

venue: OPEN STUDIO, CGV Yongsan I'Park Mall

title.en: Weverse Lucky Store at Yongsan I'Park Mall
title.es: Weverse Lucky Store en Yongsan I'Park Mall
title.zh: 龙山 I'Park Mall 的 Weverse Lucky Store
title.pt: Weverse Lucky Store no Yongsan I'Park Mall
title.ru: Weverse Lucky Store в Yongsan I'Park Mall

summary.en: An official merch store notice with opening hours, location, reservation flow, purchase notes, and tax refund reminder.
summary.es: Aviso oficial de merch con horarios, ubicación, reserva, compra y nota sobre tax refund.
summary.zh: 官方周边商店公告，含营业时间、地点、预约方式、购买须知和退税提示。
summary.pt: Aviso oficial de merch com horário, local, reserva, compra e lembrete de tax refund.
summary.ru: Официальное уведомление о merch-store с часами, адресом, бронью, правилами покупки и tax refund.

whyGo.en: Useful for fans who need official queue, reservation, refund, and sold-out rules in one place.
whyGo.es: Útil para fans que necesitan reglas oficiales de cola, reserva, reembolso y sold out.
whyGo.zh: 适合需要集中查看排队、预约、退税和售罄规则的粉丝。
whyGo.pt: Útil para fãs que precisam das regras oficiais de fila, reserva, reembolso e sold out.
whyGo.ru: Полезно фанатам, которым нужны правила очереди, брони, возврата и sold-out.

travelTips: Same-day QR reservations may close early depending on crowd levels.
Yongsan is easy to combine with the National Museum of Korea and Hangang parks.
Bring a payment card; the official notice says transactions are processed in KRW.

title.en: Shilla Duty Free Summer Event Board
title.es: Tablero de eventos de verano de Shilla Duty Free
title.zh: 新罗免税店夏季活动看板
title.pt: Painel de eventos de verão da Shilla Duty Free
title.ru: Летняя доска событий Shilla Duty Free

summary.en: The official event page lists active duty-free offers with June, summer, and long-running store date ranges.
summary.es: La página oficial lista ofertas activas de duty free con rangos de junio, verano y campañas largas.
summary.zh: 官方活动页列出六月、夏季和长期店铺优惠日期。
summary.pt: A página oficial lista ofertas duty-free ativas com datas de junho, verão e campanhas longas.
summary.ru: Официальная страница показывает активные duty-free предложения с июньскими, летними и долгосрочными датами.

whyGo.en: Duty-free event pages change often, so a monitored board gives travelers a quick check before departure.
whyGo.es: Las páginas duty free cambian a menudo; un tablero monitoreado ayuda antes de salir.
whyGo.zh: 免税活动常变化，监控看板便于游客出发前快速确认。
whyGo.pt: Páginas duty-free mudam com frequência; um painel monitorado ajuda antes da partida.
whyGo.ru: Duty-free акции часто меняются, поэтому мониторинг помогает перед вылетом.

travelTips: Always compare airport pickup rules, passport requirements, and departure date restrictions.
Some offers are store-specific; verify branch availability before going.
Use this page as a checklist, not as a substitute for the official duty-free checkout page.

title.zh: 乐天免税店 2026 年 6 月清仓活动

summary.en: A June duty-free clearance campaign; product availability and restrictions can change quickly.
summary.es: Campaña de liquidación duty free de junio; disponibilidad y restricciones pueden cambiar rápido.
summary.zh: 六月免税清仓活动，商品库存和限制可能快速变化。
summary.pt: Campanha duty-free de junho; disponibilidade e restrições podem mudar rápido.
summary.ru: Июньская duty-free распродажа; наличие и ограничения могут быстро меняться.

whyGo.en: High shopping intent and airport pickup rules make this a useful pre-departure planning page.
whyGo.es: La intención de compra y reglas de recogida en aeropuerto hacen útil esta página.
whyGo.zh: 购物意图强、机场提货规则复杂，因此适合出发前规划。
whyGo.pt: Alta intenção de compra e regras de retirada no aeroporto tornam a página útil.
whyGo.ru: Высокий покупательский интерес и правила airport pickup делают страницу полезной.

travelTips: Duty-free purchases depend on departure itinerary and pickup rules.
Alcohol and regulated products can have allowance limits.
Discounted items may sell out early.

title.en: Hyundai Department Store Pangyo Culture Picks
title.zh: 现代百货板桥店文化活动精选

summary.en: The store's official page lists culture and exhibition items running into early July, useful for a shopping-plus-art route.
summary.es: La página oficial lista exposiciones hasta inicios de julio, útil para combinar compras y arte.
summary.zh: 官方页面列出持续到七月初的文化和展览项目，适合购物加艺术路线。
summary.pt: A página oficial lista exposições até o início de julho, boa para rota compras + arte.
summary.ru: Официальная страница показывает выставки до начала июля, удобно для маршрута shopping + art.

whyGo.en: Department-store culture pages can convert casual shoppers into longer visits.
whyGo.es: Las páginas culturales de tiendas pueden convertir compras rápidas en visitas más largas.
whyGo.zh: 百货文化活动能让购物游客停留更久。
whyGo.pt: Eventos culturais em lojas podem transformar compras rápidas em visitas longas.
whyGo.ru: Культурные страницы универмагов помогают продлить визит.

travelTips: Pangyo is outside central Seoul; check subway and return time.
Combine with restaurants in the department store to reduce transit friction.
Official store pages are better for operating hours than social posts.

venue: Seoul Plaza lawn and main stage

summary.en: A public health and wellness exhibition at Seoul Plaza with outdoor visitor flow and short stay-friendly zones.
summary.es: Exposición de salud y bienestar en Seoul Plaza con zonas al aire libre y fácil visita corta.
summary.zh: 首尔广场健康与 wellness 展，户外动线，适合短时间参观。
summary.pt: Exposição de saúde e bem-estar na Seoul Plaza, ao ar livre e boa para visita curta.
summary.ru: Выставка здоровья и wellness на Seoul Plaza, удобная для короткого визита на улице.

whyGo.en: Outdoor city-center events are easy to add to a Myeongdong, palace, or Cheonggyecheon itinerary.
whyGo.es: Eventos al aire libre del centro combinan bien con Myeongdong, palacios o Cheonggyecheon.
whyGo.zh: 市中心户外活动适合搭配明洞、宫殿或清溪川行程。
whyGo.pt: Eventos ao ar livre no centro combinam com Myeongdong, palácios ou Cheonggyecheon.
whyGo.ru: События в центре удобно совмещать с Мёндоном, дворцами или Cheonggyecheon.

travelTips: Because it is outdoors, check UV, heat, and rain before visiting.
City Hall Station access makes it easy to combine with Deoksugung and Myeongdong.
Check session times on the linked official site before going.

title.es: Hub de beneficios de viaje VISITKOREA Exclusive
title.zh: VISITKOREA Exclusive 旅行优惠中心

summary.en: A Korea Tourism Organization benefits hub with partner offers across shopping, activities, performances, theme parks, lodging, and online services.
summary.es: Hub de la Organización de Turismo de Corea con ofertas de compras, actividades, espectáculos, parques, alojamiento y servicios online.
summary.zh: 韩国观光公社优惠中心，涵盖购物、体验、演出、主题乐园、住宿和线上服务。
summary.pt: Hub da Organização de Turismo da Coreia com ofertas de compras, atividades, shows, parques, hospedagem e serviços online.
summary.ru: Хаб KTO с предложениями партнеров по shopping, активностям, шоу, паркам, жилью и онлайн-сервисам.

whyGo.en: A broad official source can feed evergreen guides and recurring deal pages.
whyGo.es: Una fuente oficial amplia alimenta guías evergreen y páginas recurrentes de ofertas.
whyGo.zh: 广泛的官方来源可支撑常青指南和周期性优惠页。
whyGo.pt: Uma fonte oficial ampla alimenta guias evergreen e páginas recorrentes de ofertas.
whyGo.ru: Широкий официальный источник подходит для evergreen-гайдов и регулярных deal-страниц.

travelTips: Partner offers can change by language, app login, or coupon inventory.
Use this as a starting point for verified discounts, then confirm each partner page.
Good internal link target for shopping, performance, and theme-park articles.

venue: Korea Grand Sale locations and partners
sourceName: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism

summary.en: A completed shopping tourism festival backed by MCST and the Visit Korea Committee, useful for planning the next winter cycle.
summary.es: Festival de turismo de compras ya finalizado, útil para planear el próximo ciclo de invierno.
summary.zh: 已结束的购物旅游节，可用于规划下一季冬季活动。
summary.pt: Festival de turismo de compras encerrado, útil para planejar o próximo ciclo de inverno.
summary.ru: Завершенный shopping tourism festival, полезен для планирования следующего зимнего цикла.

whyGo.en: Archive pages create seasonal SEO value while making clear that offers are no longer active.
whyGo.es: Las páginas archivo aportan SEO estacional y dejan claro que las ofertas terminaron.
whyGo.zh: 档案页有季节性 SEO 价值，同时明确优惠已结束。
whyGo.pt: Páginas de arquivo geram SEO sazonal e deixam claro que ofertas encerraram.
whyGo.ru: Архивные страницы дают сезонный SEO и четко показывают, что предложения завершены.

travelTips: Use the archive for next-season keyword research.
Create a watch reminder for December 2026 and January 2027.
Do not display expired coupons as active offers.

sourceName: Seoul Metropolitan Government Monthly Event Calendar

summary.en: A public Hangang River sports festival built around running, cycling, and swimming at Ttukseom Hangang Park.

whyGo.en: Hangang events are easy for visitors to understand and plan because the river parks connect well with subway, picnic routes, cafes, and evening views.

travelTips: Use Ttukseom Resort Station and allow extra time around peak event hours.
June riverside weather can feel hot and humid, so bring water, sunscreen, and a light rain layer.
Combine the event with Common Ground, Seongsu cafes, or an evening Hangang picnic.

venue: Central Dalbit Plaza, Banpo Hangang Park
sourceName: Seoul Metropolitan Government Monthly Event Calendar

summary.en: A free Korean traditional music festival at Banpo Hangang Park with performances and hands-on cultural experiences.

whyGo.en: It gives first-time visitors a simple way to experience Korean traditional music in an outdoor river setting.

travelTips: Arrive before sunset if you want a good riverside spot.
Pair the festival with Banpo Bridge Rainbow Fountain, Some Sevit, and Express Bus Terminal shopping.
Use public transit because parking and taxi demand can spike around evening events.

sourceName: Seoul Metropolitan Government Monthly Event Calendar

summary.en: A free outdoor classical music concert by the Hangang River at Yeouido Hangang Park.

whyGo.en: Free riverside concerts are strong tourist pages because visitors check timing, crowd levels, weather, and transport repeatedly.

travelTips: Bring a compact picnic mat and check rain notices before leaving.
Yeouinaru Station is convenient, but exits may crowd before and after the concert.
Combine with The Hyundai Seoul, IFC Mall, or a Yeouido river walk.

sourceName: Seoul Metropolitan Government Monthly Event Calendar

title.en: 2026 Gugak Week: Sound Ritual Ensemble Cy

summary.en: A paid Korean traditional performance at Seoul Donhwamun Traditional Theater near the palace and Ikseon-dong area.

whyGo.en: Indoor cultural performances are useful rainy-day alternatives and pair well with palace-area sightseeing.

travelTips: Reserve tickets through the official venue before planning the night.
Combine with Changdeokgung, Jongmyo, Insadong, and Ikseon-dong before the show.
Leave time for narrow streets and weekend crowds around Jongno.

venue: Seoul Baekje Hall, Seoul Baekje Museum
sourceName: Seoul Metropolitan Government Monthly Event Calendar

summary.en: A free one-hour classical concert at Seoul Baekje Museum with commentary for easier listening.

whyGo.en: Museum concerts can extend a short Olympic Park visit into a culture-focused half day.

travelTips: Check museum admission and concert seating rules before departure.
Pair with Olympic Park, Mongchontoseong Fortress, and Jamsil shopping.
Good option for hot or rainy afternoons because it is indoors.

sourceName: Seoul Metropolitan Government Monthly Event Calendar

title.en: 2026 Seoul Garden Festival at Seoul Forest

summary.en: A Seoul Forest garden festival with weekend performances, activity programs, and reservation-based Saturday stage events.

whyGo.en: It connects naturally with Seongsu cafes, Seoul Forest walks, and low-friction weekend plans for visitors staying in eastern Seoul.

travelTips: Check reservation rules for Saturday performances before visiting.
Pair the festival with Seongsu cafes, Ttukseom Hangang Park, or Common Ground.
Because the festival is outdoors, check rain, heat, and fine dust before leaving.

venue: Theme Garden Rose Garden, Seoul Grand Park

title.en: 2026 Seoul Grand Park Rose Garden Festival

summary.en: A late-spring rose garden festival at Seoul Grand Park, useful as an archive and planning benchmark for future flower seasons.

whyGo.en: Flower festivals are strong travel-planning pages because visitors compare bloom timing, weather, transport, photo spots, and nearby family activities.

travelTips: Use Seoul Grand Park Station and allow extra time because the park area is wide.
Pair with Seoul Zoo, National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art Gwacheon, or the lake walk.
For future seasons, check the official page again because flower timing depends on weather.
